relations.rationale: Bringing the first-aid kit has no bearing on Isla's finishing position last year.
Jun chatting about checkpoint markings doesn't indicate whether the group moved toward the starting line together.
Standing chatting with an official is a separate activity from finishing stretching; they don't directly imply each other.
Jun chatting with an official doesn't establish whether he later rejoined others at the timing mats.
Milo's team membership with Jun has no connection to Zeno and Isla's readiness for the climb.
Milo being on Jun's team doesn't determine whether Jun is on Hana's team, though both could be true simultaneously without contradiction.
Milo's team affiliation has no bearing on Isla's statement about race timing.

If Milo is on the same team as Jun, and Milo is not on the same team as Hana, this supports that Jun and Hana are likely not on the same team either, but this is about Milo-Hana directly which is separate from the inference target.
Zeno being a year older than Isla doesn't imply anything about their perceived readiness for a climb.
Age difference between Zeno and Isla is unrelated to spectators lining fences at the final stretch.
Zeno and Isla's readiness for the climb has no connection to Milo's height compared to other cyclists.
Their equal readiness for the climb doesn't relate to Isla's comment about race start timing.
Readiness for the climb is unrelated to spectators at the final stretch.
Equal readiness for the climb doesn't bear on last year's ranking between Hana and Isla.
Their readiness assessment doesn't relate to weather conditions at the starting horn.
Hana laughing at Zeno's weather comment has no bearing on Milo's height.
Hana laughing at something Zeno said doesn't relate to whether Milo is on her team.
The group moving to the starting line together doesn't relate to last year's finishing order between Hana and Isla.
The group moving toward the starting line together is consistent with and supports the subsequent surge of cyclists onto the road as the race begins.
Jun not being on Hana's team is a separate fact from Milo not being on Hana's team; they don't imply each other.
